el.¿Qué es el Posgrado en Yoga Esencial?: What is the Postgraduate in Essential Yoga?
el.Son tres meses de formación avanzada, on: Three months of advanced training, online and live, focused on three tools for teaching: Chair Yoga, Yoga Nidra, and creative visualizations.
el.¿Puedo hacer el Posgrado sin haber hecho: Can I take the Postgraduate Program without having done the Instructor Training?
el.Sí, si ya tenés una formación previa en: Yes, if you already have previous training in Yoga or are already teaching. If you're coming from the Instructor Training, it's the natural next step: same day, same time, and same group.
el.De septiembre a noviembre de 2027, los m: From September to November 2027, on Tuesdays from 7 to 9 pm, Argentina time. One topic per month.
el.¿Cuánto sale el Posgrado?: How much does the Postgraduate Program cost?

el.¿Puedo cursar un solo módulo?: Can I take just one module?
